verification.method: scripts/verify/energy-110.py reads the original Global Carbon Project and Ember files (data/raw/energy/) with Python's csv module, not the site's generated data; scripts/check-energy.mjs compares all 94,154 generated values with the original files; then the text was read by hand
verification.what: every ranking row (194 countries and areas, order and value capped at 100%), the CSV, every figure in the text, FAQ, title, description and JSON-LD; claims: the seven countries at 100% and their hydro share above half, Iceland's other-renewables share, order among the 36 systems above 100 TWh, wind-and-solar leaders, world share rising every year since 2008, wind and solar more than tripled since 2015, China's share of world renewable power, Bangladesh
verification.against: Global Carbon Project fossil CO2 emissions dataset 2026v11 (Zenodo, CC BY 4.0) and Ember Yearly Electricity Data (downloaded 26 November 2026, CC BY 4.0); UN WPP 2024 country list
verification.result: All automated comparisons matched; before publishing, ties in the ranking were given a fixed order (by ISO code), the 2024 ranking year for Ember (its 2025 data cover only part of the world) was made explicit, and unsupported wording ('small oil- and gas-producing states', 'mainly geothermal', 'cleanest power mix') was replaced with what the data show

changelog.note: First version: Ember Yearly Electricity Data (downloaded 26 November 2026) for 2024.
